retrievalProfile.description: A vertical split-screen layout featuring a full-body studio portrait of a musical group on the left and a high-contrast black sidebar with stacked, multi-style typography on the right.
triggerTerms: split screen with black sidebar and white text
sequined dresses and tuxedo studio shot

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person musical group (two women in sparkling gowns, one man in a suit) posed dynamically against a clean white background, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, while the right third is a solid black vertical panel containing white and red text in varying weights and styles.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between white photographic space and black typographic space
Repetition of sequined texture in female attire
Contrast between the dynamic, joyful poses and the rigid, structured sidebar
Color coordination between red text accents and the thin red vertical divider
coreInvariants: High-key white background for the subject
Solid black sidebar on the right edge
Thin red vertical line separating the two main zones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered in the left white panel, full-body, scaled to fill the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central male figure in a dark suit provides a stable anchor for the two flanking figures in light-reflecting gowns.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the faces of the trio, moves right to the large display text, then down the list of tracks in the sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space around the subjects to emphasize their silhouette and movement.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red for secondary headings and the vertical divider line
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the panels; low saturation except for the red accents.

letterConstructionRules: Primary display text is ultra-condensed, tall, and all-caps
Secondary text uses a high-contrast serif with italic styling
Tertiary list text uses a clean, medium-weight sans-serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast (ultra-condensed vs normal) and style contrast (sans-serif vs serif).

preserve: Right-side alignment of the text block
avoid: Overlapping text on the photographic subject

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ultra-condensed, bold, vertical energy of the main title.
Provides the high-contrast, elegant serif look for the red subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a studio portrait of a three-person musical group (one man in a dark suit, two women in sequined gowns) on a pure white background, positioned in the left two-thirds of the frame. The right third should be a solid black vertical panel separated by a thin red line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed white sans-serif text at the top of the black panel, followed by red serif italic text in the middle, and a list of white sans-serif text at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the sidebar exactly on the right side?
Is there a thin red line separating the white and black sections?
Is the main title text ultra-condensed and all-caps?
Are the subjects in full-body view?

adjustableVariables: Color of the accent text (red to gold/blue)
Specific font choice within the condensed sans-serif family
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Any specific brand logos or collection names
Exact facial features of the original performers

mustAchieve: Dynamic, joyful energy in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red divider line is perfectly vertical.
Check that the sequined texture is visible and reflective.
Verify that the text does not touch the edges of the black sidebar.
Confirm the white background is blown out and shadowless.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait on white + solid color sidebar + vertical divider + mixed-style stacked typography.
